meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Use this when the user asks to search memory, "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or wants work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速找回之前会话中解决过的问题和做法
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常想从过往对话里快速找回答案。
copy.tagline_en: Recall past solutions and how you did things before.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to dig up answers from earlier conversations.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能检索 claude-mem 的跨会话记忆库:按关键词、项目、类型、日期找以往会话的记录,先看带 ID 的索引,再看时间线,最后取完整详情。
howto.when: 当你问起之前的会话,比如「这个问题之前解决过吗」「上次是怎么做的」,或需要以往会话的工作内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜一下之前的会话,看我们有没有解决过登录报错的问题。
say.note: 先返回带 ID 的结果列表

say.text: 上个月我们是怎么处理数据库迁移的?
say.note: 按时间线和项目过滤后再取详情

say.text: 把 ID 11131 和 10942 的完整记录一起拉出来。
say.note: 一次批量获取完整记录

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can search claude-mem's cross-session memory: find past work by keyword, project, type, or date, view an ID index, then timeline context, then full details.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about earlier sessions, e.g. "did we already solve this?" or "how did we do X last time?", or need work from previous sessions.

say_en.text: Search past sessions — did we ever fix that login error?
How did we handle the database migration last month?
say_en.note: Filters by timeline and project, then fetches

say_en.text: Fetch the full records for IDs 11131 and 10942 together.
